description: This file defines the 'PaymentAddress' controller class for the checkout process in an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages displaying, saving, and selecting payment address information, including address validation, handling custom fields, and interaction with session and model components.

classes.name: PaymentAddress
classes.description: Controller class managing the payment address selection, creation, and validation during checkout.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the payment address selection view, loads necessary data like addresses, countries, custom fields, and language, returning the rendered view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing payment address, performing validation, updating session data, and returning JSON response.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Loads a specific address based on address_id, validates user session and cart, updates session data, and returns JSON response.
